pairing_sessions_claim_check.name: pairing_sessions_claim_check
pairing_sessions_claim_check.value: ("pairing_sessions"."claimed_at" is null) = ("pairing_sessions"."organization_id" is null) and ("pairing_sessions"."claimed_at" is null) = ("pairing_sessions"."player_id" is null)

media_ready_complete.name: media_ready_complete
media_ready_complete.value: "media"."status" <> 'ready' or ("media"."checksum_sha256" is not null and "media"."size_bytes" is not null and "media"."mime_type" is not null)

programs_org_live_idx.name: programs_org_live_idx
programs_org_live_idx.where: "programs"."published_version_id" is not null and "programs"."cancelled_at" is null and "programs"."deleted_at" is null

timeline_events_player_source_check.name: timeline_events_player_source_check
timeline_events_player_source_check.value: "timeline_events"."source" = 'cloud' or ("timeline_events"."event_id" is not null and "timeline_events"."player_id" is not null)
